_readme: このファイルが生成プロンプトの唯一の定義。tools/prompts.mjs（事前生成）と index.html（アップロード写真の実行時生成）の両方がこれを読む。i2i プロンプトは rules → styles[key].material → layouts[roomType][n] → quality の順に連結する。rules はコンプライアンス要件なので削らない。透かし・法定表記はモデルに描かせず、サーバー側で sharp で合成する（api/_stamp.js）。モデルに描かせると (1) 文字が崩れることがある (2) Google の安全フィルタが「透かし除去の依頼」と誤判定して生成そのものを弾くことがある。
rules: This is a virtual staging job for a real-estate listing. The room itself must not change. KEEP IDENTICAL to the source photo: camera position, focal length, perspective and framing; every wall, the ceiling and its light fitting; the floor material, colour and grain direction; the window / balcony sash and the view through it; every door, handle, baseboard, outlet, switch and the air-conditioner. Do not widen, extend, shrink or re-proportion the room. Do not add or remove windows, doors or walls. Do not repaint the walls or replace the flooring. Keep the existing daylight direction, colour temperature and intensity. ONLY add free-standing furniture, rugs, curtains, lamps and decor that rest on the existing floor or hang flat on the existing walls, each casting a physically correct contact shadow that matches the existing light. The output must be PIXEL-ALIGNED with the input: every architectural edge — the room corners, the window and balcony frame, the door, the ceiling line, the floor line and the horizon — must stay at exactly the same position in the frame as in the source photo, and the vanishing point must not move. Do not re-frame, re-crop, zoom in or out, pan, tilt, rotate, straighten or change the lens or the field of view. Think of this as painting furniture onto the existing photograph, not re-rendering the room from a new viewpoint: if you laid the output over the input, the two rooms would coincide exactly.
quality: QUALITY: photorealistic architectural interior photography for a premium listing, full-frame camera with a 17mm tilt-shift lens, verticals perfectly straight, ultra sharp across the frame, high resolution, fine material texture (oak grain, wool, linen, ceramic, brushed metal), natural white balance, soft realistic global illumination, subtle depth of field, interior-magazine styling with generous negative space. No people, no pets, no brand logos, no clutter, no duplicated furniture, no floating objects, and no text, caption, logo or watermark anywhere in the image.

wa_modern.label: 和モダン
wa_modern.description: 木の質感と落ち着いた色調で、和の空気感を残したスタイル
wa_modern.material: STYLE — Japandi / modern Japanese: low-slung furniture, solid white-oak and walnut, warm greige and ecru fabrics, washi paper shades, matte black steel accents, one deep moss-green or indigo accent, ceramic and dried botanicals. Muted earth palette, horizontal lines, calm and uncluttered.

natural.label: ナチュラル
natural.description: 明るい木目とやわらかな色合いの、北欧テイストのスタイル
natural.material: STYLE — Scandinavian natural: pale ash and birch wood, off-white boucle and undyed linen, jute and wool rugs, soft sage and terracotta accents, plenty of live greenery, rattan and light ceramics. Bright, airy, friendly, everything a shade lighter than the walls.

hotel.label: ホテルライク
hotel.description: 低めの家具と落ち着いた色で、上質な印象にまとめたスタイル
hotel.material: STYLE — luxury hotel suite: deep charcoal, ink-navy and taupe upholstery, dark walnut and smoked oak, honed marble and brushed-brass details, a low-pile silk-look rug, symmetrical arrangement, layered warm lighting from floor and table lamps. Restrained, expensive, editorial.

living: LAYOUT 1 — conversation setting: a three-seat sofa against the long wall facing the window, a low rectangular coffee table on a large area rug, a floor lamp in the corner, two framed prints hung on the empty wall, sheer full-height curtains at the window, one large potted tree beside the balcony and a small side table with a ceramic vase.

LAYOUT 2 — dining-led plan: a four-seat dining table with matching chairs and a bench placed in the centre of the room, a slim sideboard along the wall with two objects and a table lamp on top, a tall arc floor lamp leaning over the table, a flat-weave rug under the dining set, sheer curtains, one medium plant in the corner.

LAYOUT 3 — open lounge: a compact two-seat sofa angled towards the balcony with a lounge chair and footstool opposite, a round side table between them, a low media console with a slim TV on the wall opposite the sofa, a round rug, a reading floor lamp, a stack of books, two plants of different heights and a large framed artwork leaning against the wall.
bedroom: LAYOUT 1 — classic bedroom: a double bed centred on the main wall with a headboard, two pillows and a folded throw, a nightstand with a table lamp on each side, a small round rug beside the bed, sheer and blackout curtain layers at the window and one framed print above the headboard.

LAYOUT 2 — bedroom with a work corner: a double bed pushed towards the window wall, one nightstand with a lamp, a slim desk with a chair and a task lamp against the opposite wall, a low open bookshelf with a few books and a plant, and a runner rug.

LAYOUT 3 — hotel-style bed setting: a low double bed with a wide upholstered headboard, a bench at the foot of the bed, symmetrical nightstands and lamps, a tall slim plant in the corner, a large soft rug extending under the bed and floor-length curtains.
